title: Amazing 10/10
text: Violeta was the BEST skipper. She did everything to make our trip personal and memorable! Be brought out 2 year old daughter, and she made the experience the most WONDERFUL experience for her (and for us). The pictures of my daughter and her Barbie doll enjoying the sailboat with Violeta are some of my favorite photos from our trip to Barcelona. Violeta is a wonderful, kind, and beautiful person, and above all, a skilled sailor. It was a pleasure being on her boat. We wish we could bring her home with us!!! HIGHLY recommend this to anyone. If you're wondering whether to book, the answer is, "Y

title: Perfect for couples
text: A wonderful afternoon with Lluís. It was a lovely host, very attentive. Everything was perfect from start to finish. He gave us good suggestions on what to do and then left us total freedom to enjoy ourselves at our own pace, without interrupting us. A relaxed and perfect experience. We especially recommend choosing sunset times. Thank you very much Lluís!
